scope: Offline retrospective context acquisition feasibility and controlled history-scope experiment; no live traffic or exploitation
requested_compositions: Procedure history with request-bound verification observations
available_compositions: Preceding 16 requests of the actual directional endpoint pair
Preceding 16 requests of a directional transport connection with observed SYN generation
unavailable: No true cross-function procedure identifiers in published decoded captures
No request-bound CU/runtime witness observations for these captures
Existing native-CU signed witnesses concern different deployments and must not be joined
design: 3 original objectives x 4 available arms x 3 fixed seeds = 36 fits; Granomaly only, all eligible test rows, no resampling or cap
data: Original pinned public CSVs aligned bitwise to Granomaly matrices from Actions run 41096216782; original splits, labels, normalization and base operation coding unchanged
input: Common 83-dimensional input: 77 original base dimensions and six reserved observation dimensions (three check values and three availability masks). All reserved dimensions zero in the present four-arm experiment. Every arm has the same architecture and initialized parameter shapes.
training: Common projection/GRU 48 and original three output heads; original permutation, categorical forecast and MSE reconstruction objectives unchanged to isolate grouping. 12 epochs, 512 batch, AdamW lr .001 weight_decay .0001, clip 5, two CPU threads, seeds 11/29/47. Current vectors already include causal count/gap summaries.
causality: History contains only strictly earlier row indices; partitions reset histories; no current/future request or response enters model vectors. Transport/procedure IDs are grouping keys only, not features. Unknown endpoints do not share histories merely because their model vocabulary ID is zero.
observations: Optional pinned P-256 collector signature binding capture SHA256, deployment ID, request index and pre-request observation time (age <=5 seconds). Missing checks have availability mask zero, not pass. Complete alignment across every partition required to enable procedure/procedure_witness training. No check value is synthesized from labels or normal assumptions. A collector signature authenticates assertions, not physical measurement independence.
primary: SMF: 706 original positive requests and 2509 original normal requests with known endpoints. Score full streams before applying strata. Original scenario labels are not independently verified malicious outcomes.
thresholds: Calibration-only empirical upper quantiles .001/.01, frozen before any test. Primary budget requires actual SMF and clean-holdout FPR <=.001 in all three seeds. No post-hoc polarity, threshold or seed selection.
report: Full and known-participant AP, recall, actual FPR, TP/FP, clean FPR, conditional 512-request block intervals (200 replicates), false alarms per capture hour. Pairwise scope contrasts use matched seeds; not independent deployments. Source-annotation and response summaries audit-only, no relabelling.
full_requested_three_composition_test: Unavailable pending actual procedure and verification observations; transport histories are explicitly a proxy experiment, never claimed as that test
